title: MetadataMatchCandidatesPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'metadata.match-candidates'. Phosphor retheme Wave 2 (Lane L2, Fix Match): emitted once by the 'metadata-search' job handler (apps/worker/src/metadata/match-search-consumer.ts) after it has finished a bounded provider-chain search for one item — CLAUDE.md invariant 6 means the search itself runs in the worker, never inline in the POST /admin/items/{id}/match-search request path. ADMIN-ONLY delivery — see envelope.schema.json's x-loombre-admin-only-event-types + @loombre/shared admin-only-event-types (the canonical classification, L3 owner brief): candidate titles/years are catalog data an admin's own restricted-content clearance already gates elsewhere, and this event carries no per-viewer redaction of its own — treat it the same as any other admin-only operational event, not as a content-list surface a non-admin could ever legitimately receive.

itemId.description: The catalog item this search was run for.

jobId.description: The 'metadata-search' job that produced this result — lets a client that enqueued several searches match results back to the right item.

providersSearched.description: ADDITIVE-OPTIONAL (d4-e1, backlog #081). The providers this search actually ran against, in the item's resolved chain order — a provider that was asked and THREW is still listed (it was asked). An EMPTY array is the load-bearing case: the chain was resolved and every provider in it was skipped as disabled, which is what a keyless instance always looks like, so an empty candidates[] means 'nothing was searched', not 'searched and found nothing'. The field is OMITTED (never []) when no search stage was reached at all — the item vanished mid-flight, was not an enrichable type, or its library was gone — because those are races, not a provider-configuration problem, and a client must fall back to its generic copy for them. An older server omits it everywhere; that degrades to exactly the pre-d4-e1 copy rather than to a wrong answer.

candidates.description: Every result found across the item's resolved provider chain, ranked best-first (apps/worker/src/metadata/match.ts's title/year scoring, normalized 0-100). Empty when no provider in the chain returned any result — or, indistinguishably before d4-e1, when no provider was searched at all; see providersSearched.

isBest.description: True for exactly one candidate (the highest-scored) when candidates is non-empty; false for every candidate when candidates is empty.
